summary: Petrobras filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of the first installment (R$ 752 million) of an economic subvention program for diesel oil commercialization under Brazilian Provisional Measure No. 1,340. This is a routine operational update regarding a government subsidy payment—not a special situation. The filing contains standard risk language and no transaction, strategic change, or corporate event. No deal terms, board actions, or structural mechanics are involved. As a foreign private issuer's current report on Form 6-K, this is mapped to a routine US reporting obligation. The filing has no special-situation content and is classified accordingly.
